description: This header file declares functions and structures related to launching editors within a version control system, likely Git. It includes function prototypes for editing files, sequence editing, terminal type checking, and associated utility functions.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Returns the preferred editor command for Git.

methods.name: git_sequence_editor
methods.description: Returns the editor command used for sequence operations.

methods.name: is_terminal_dumb
methods.description: Checks if the terminal is 'dumb' (limited capabilities).

methods.name: launch_editor
methods.description: Launches the user's preferred editor to edit a file, fills buffer with contents after editing.

methods.name: launch_sequence_editor
methods.description: Launches editor for sequence operations, similar to launch_editor.

methods.name: strbuf_edit_interactively
methods.description: Writes the buffer to a file, launches editor, then reads back into buffer, deleting temporary file afterward.
